agent: SentinelGraph: An Autonomous Data Security Agent for DataHub
aiSummary: SentinelGraph is an AI agent that autonomously monitors DataHub for security risks. For customer_orders in Finance, it assigned a high threat level with score 72 after reasoning over PII tags, customer schema fields, ownership, assertions, and downstream lineage. Its lineage analysis found a blast radius of 2 downstream assets and recommends tightening PII controls before publishing further revenue extracts.

findings.description: Dataset contains customer_email and billing_zip fields tagged as PII and feeds downstream finance reporting.
findings.recommendation: Apply DataHub classification review, access policy validation, and masking recommendations for downstream assets.

findings.description: Two downstream assets depend on this dataset, including an executive dashboard.
findings.recommendation: Notify owners and add a DataHub assertion recommendation for PII-safe publication.
